hypothesis: Broadcom の sold non-recourse receivables を balance sheet に戻す factoring-neutral DSO range を構築すると、NVIDIA - Broadcom の観測 DSO 差 12.53 日は 10 日未満まで縮小し得る。

precommit.USE: 一次情報だけで構築した factoring-neutral range の全域で NVIDIA - Broadcom DSO 差が 10 日未満になる。
precommit.CONDITION: range が 10 日閾値を跨ぎ、sold receivables の期中残高または残存期間不足で一点推定できない。
precommit.REJECT: factoring-neutral range の全域で DSO 差が 10 日以上残る。
precommit.UNVERIFIED: source / identity / period / unit が不足する。

sources.avgo_form: Broadcom Inc. Form 10-Q, two fiscal quarters ended 2026-05-03
sources.nvda_form: NVIDIA Corporation Form 10-Q, six months ended 2026-07-26

method.range_logic: The filing discloses 2.350B USD of H1 factoring proceeds but not the average outstanding balance or residual maturity of sold receivables. Therefore no point estimate is inferred. Sensitivity adds 0%, 50%, and 100% of disclosed H1 sold receivables to average reported receivables. The 100% case is an intentionally conservative balance-sheet add-back sensitivity, not a claim that all H1 proceeds were outstanding simultaneously.
method.warning: Factoring proceeds are a flow; DSO requires an average receivable stock. Flow-to-stock identity is not assumed.

benchmark_and_alternative.benchmark: Reported-balance DSO: AVGO 39.42 days versus NVDA 51.95 days, a 12.53-day gap.
benchmark_and_alternative.alternative: A factoring-neutral AVGO collection cycle can be materially longer because sold receivables are absent from reported balances. Even a 50% flow add-back sensitivity reduces the observed gap to 7.38 days.

decision.reason: The reported 12.53-day NVIDIA DSO premium is not robust to plausible factoring-neutral sensitivities: a 50% add-back reduces it below the 10-day materiality threshold. However, Broadcom does not disclose the average outstanding sold-receivable stock or residual maturity, so a single factoring-neutral DSO cannot be identified from canonical data without inventing a flow-to-stock mapping.
decision.rule: Do not use the reported 12.53-day DSO gap as a standalone NVDA customer-financing premium. Show reported DSO together with the factoring-neutral sensitivity range. Reclassify only when Broadcom discloses enough sold-receivable stock/maturity information to identify a point estimate or when comparable credit-loss evidence becomes available.

risk_metrics.reason: Point-in-time working-capital comparability research, not a realized trading strategy.

limitations: 2.350B USD is H1 factoring proceeds, a flow, not average sold-receivable stock.
The filing does not disclose the average residual maturity of receivables sold during H1.
The 50% and 100% add-backs are transparent sensitivities, not estimated economic balances.
DSO remains a financing/collection diagnostic and is not a default probability or expected-loss estimate.
next_high_value_hypothesis: Use issuer disclosures to compare AVGO and NVDA accounts-receivable growth against sequential revenue growth and operating cash flow over multiple quarters, testing whether receivable build persistently outruns revenue rather than relying on a single H1 DSO snapshot.
